decision: Loader proof did not pass. The EventStore 5.3.0 loader now admits net11 owner children (no System.Text.Json refusal), but owner preparation still refuses the Parties child, so the required live case never gets past owner preparation. Per the frozen I/O matrix the full move stopped here: no ChatBot commit, fetch, push, registration or adoption. Human decisions are needed (see blockers).

blockers.summary: No single EventStore SDK satisfies both owner children: Tenants v8.0.2 accepts only 5.3.0 or 5.3.1 (Tenants Directory.Build.targets:45, blob 1389f838849715383a8f5cda33e8678281d2a3ec), while Parties main enables its compiled owner declarations only up to 5.1.1. Needs a Parties release that qualifies the 5.3.x catalog API; ChatBot cannot fix this without editing a sibling.

Plan target Projects 69697a08 does not compile in package mode: Projects.Server uses Conversations query APIs that no released Conversations package provides, and its own Directory.Packages.props (blob f56d16dfc2e951732ff1c7644f86da4ce951e9f8) still pins EventStore 5.1.1 while its Contracts need QueryResultContract from 5.3.0. A Conversations release, a Projects release, or an approved older Projects pin is needed.

Builds v6.3.1 (catalog blob 4ef88b0ab9cb71504521cb66c1baf66cd36c673e) pins Aspire 13.6.5, and its exception inventory (blob fa96cbf95edc79e4e88eb55bf2466c34cb674ebf) requires the ChatBot AppHost SDK to equal it. ChatBot base pins Aspire.AppHost.Sdk 17.0.0, which fails restore with NU1109. Aspire 17 first appears in Builds v6.3.2 (38e038d1179b1c829ba47a45bfa0a4683ea5e2a5), which is not CiCd's builds-version. The proof used SDK 13.6.5; keeping Aspire 17 needs a different Builds decision.
